item.title: Version 0.6.7
item.description:
What's New

  • A Nixie clock overlay: one tube clock per display, on the desktop or above your windows. Drag it to move it, drag its corner to resize
  • System Overview tile for the Monitor board — CPU, memory, network, disk and power in a single widget
  • A wallpaper that fails to load now says so on the display's page: what failed and why, with Retry, the full details, and a prefilled problem report. Your desktop keeps the wallpaper it had, and the card names it
  • The Workshop detail sheet lists the items a wallpaper requires, each openable on its own
  • Settings ▸ Workshop: a default sort and time frame for Browse, blurred Mature covers, and hiding items already in your library

Improvements

  • Browsing the Workshop without a Steam API key now reads Steam's own browse page: one request per page, with creator names and a real page count
  • Keyed search gained tag groups and search-field targeting, and falls back to the keyless path by itself when Valve rejects the key
  • Maturity starts at Everyone, the way the signed-out Steam page browses
  • Workshop requests retry a dropped connection or a busy server; a rate limit reports how long it lasts instead of hanging on it
  • The Processes and agent tiles show each process's own app icon

Bug Fixes

  • Board edit controls were about seven points tall in the inspector preview
  • The log sheet kept its first page of text when the log grew while it was open
  • Pro: trail particles — rain among them — pointed the wrong way on rotated or scaled emitters
  • Pro: an object's alpha script never reached its particles, and animated textures were loaded in the wrong colour space

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen.app" once; updates Loomscreen installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
